findings.obligation: every finding carries a HOW the maintainer can follow
findings.observation: The HOW line is: "echo disable-ccid >> $config$running." The sentence period follows the path directly when no scdaemon runs, so copying the command writes to scdaemon.conf. (a different file) and the finding stays after re-run.
findings.remediation: End the HOW without a trailing period or put the command in its own clause, e.g. "run: echo disable-ccid >> $config" with the restart as a separate sentence.

findings.obligation: README steps are correct for the committed entrypoint.sh
findings.observation: README says: "for a second machine or a test run give it another name". register_runner copies the registration into the shared volume codesign-runner-state (entrypoint.sh:154), so a test registration on the same machine overwrites the production registration and the always-on runner then runs under the test name.
findings.remediation: State that another name is for a second machine only, or that a same-machine test run replaces the production registration and the production runner must be registered again afterwards.

findings.obligation: a stranger can set up a fresh machine from the README alone
findings.observation: Prerequisites say "watchtower, run regularly" with no install or run command; README line 150 uses ykman piv info and README line 123 uses the gh CLI, neither listed as a prerequisite or installed by any step.
findings.remediation: Give the watchtower command or state that it is optional and how else the machine gets a new image; name ykman and gh as optional tools for the PIN check and the old-runner removal.

findings.obligation: retirement step matches what check-host.sh detects
findings.observation: README: "docker image rm local/osslsigncode-ossl3:trixie". The tag trixie comes only from the design text; no committed file builds it, while check-host.sh matches every tag of the repository, so on a machine with another tag the README command fails and check-host prints the right reference.
findings.remediation: Write the removal for the reference shown by docker images local/osslsigncode-ossl3, with trixie as the expected example.

findings.obligation: HOW for the host runner is complete and agrees with the README
findings.observation: HOW says "...sudo ./svc.sh uninstall and ./config.sh remove, then delete that folder." config.sh remove without --token prompts for a token, while the README step gives the remove-token form. Also check_scdaemon (line 79) stays quiet when disable-ccid exists even if a scdaemon started before the line still runs and holds the key.
findings.remediation: Point the HOW to the README remove command or add the token form; flag a running scdaemon even when the config line exists, or document that a restart is needed.
